body:
Hi

Is there any json with the data from ASVS and the mapped NIST controls? I would like to write a tool that checks the controls needed against those two frameworks.

If it does not exist, is this something that can be created? I would be happy to be part of this, if it happens :)

Thanks

Ok. My idea is to have a service that receives a keyword (eg - database, authentication etc...) and it returns the relevant ASVS/NIST controls related to this. Do you think this would be a good idea? If so, should be part of this project or an independent project?

So I know there is this but not sure if it is updated for V4 and not sure if it includes a conversion to JSON
https://github.com/Santandersecurityresearch/asvs

If the main ASVS repository doesn't include a script to convert the GitHub markdown to JSON (you should check the shell scripts) then that would be a good addition to the repository (open a PR) but, if the application above doesn't help you then the querying application should be a different repository.

Great! Will use this then. I feel its better to keep this as a separate application, although its just an idea inside my head..)

Thanks for the help. I will close the issue now
ok thanks, feel free to share what you come up with :)
